name: ledgerguard
description: LedgerGuard - a self-hosted double-entry bookkeeping and financial ledger platform

scripts.predev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stop-stale-ledgerguard.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-mongo27018.ps1
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
